idea-plugin.name: Elemenx
idea-plugin.description: Elemenx and ElemenxUI in the editor: completion of the Components, their props, events and the directives in the templates, the Services in the code, their documentation on hover, go to the definition of a Component or of a function of a template, and the diagnostics of unknown Components, props, events and directives. Through the language server of Elemenx and LSP4IJ; it needs Node.js (ELEMENX_NODE names another one than the node of PATH).

server.name: Elemenx
server.description: The language server of Elemenx: the templates and the code of an Elemenx project.
